授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）:
材料の特性はその構成要素の性質だけでなく，異なる材料や相の組み合わせ，形態，配置，さらにはそれらの間に形成される界面によって大きく変化する．複数の異なる材料を人為的に組み合わせる複合材料は，このような「複合化」によって，単一の材料では得ることのできない特性や機能を発現させる代表的な材料設計手法である．
本講義では繊維強化複合材料を主な題材として，複合則，強化材，界面を介した応力伝達，構成相の変形・破断と多重破断，複合材料の製造法などを学び，複合化によって材料特性が発現する基本的な考え方を理解する．さらに，複合化という考え方を異なる材料や相から構成される様々な材料系を捉えるための視点として認識し，受講者自身の研究対象における「複合」とは何か，また本講義で得た考え方を自らの研究にどのように活用できるかを考える契機とする．
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
The properties of materials are determined not only by the properties of their individual constituents, but also by the combination, morphology, and spatial arrangement of different materials or phases, as well as by the interfaces formed between them. Composite materials, in which two or more different materials are intentionally combined, represent a typical approach to materials design based on such “composite design” enabling properties and functions that cannot be achieved with a single material alone.
This course uses fiber-reinforced composites as the primary subject to introduce the fundamental concepts underlying the development of material properties through composite design. Topics include the rule of mixtures, reinforcing materials, stress transfer across interfaces, deformation and fracture of constituent phases and multiple fracture, and manufacturing processes for composite materials. The course also encourages students to recognize composite design as a perspective for understanding a wide variety of material systems consisting of different materials or phases, and to consider what “composite” means in the context of their own research and how the concepts learned in this course can be applied to their research.
